item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Old-fashioned roast chicken filled with fresh parsley, served with boiled white potatoes and a classic brown gravy, topped with peas tossed with parsley. With home-made cucumber salad and sweet rhubarb compote. The dish is gluten free. (6)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Japanese teriyaki chicken with noodles and stir-fried vegetables (broccoli, carrot and green beans), topped with roasted sesame seeds and finely sliced spring onion. With pickled ginger, lime and mild chilli mayo. Also served gluten free. (1+2+7+8+11+13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Japanese teriyaki tofu with noodles and stir-fried vegetables (broccoli, carrot and green beans), topped with roasted sesame seeds and finely sliced spring onion. With pickled ginger, lime and mild vegan chilli mayo. Also served gluten free and vegan. (1+2+7+8+11+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Spanish spiced chicken in tomato sauce with lightly smoked serrano, served with fried potatoes and parsley. (10+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Fried herb patty on split peas in a spiced tomato sauce, served with fried potatoes and parsley. (10+15) Kays — 7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Chicken curry – yellow curry with plenty of greens and chickpeas, served with rice. (13+15) GREEN DISH: Dish "No chicken" curry – yellow curry with plenty of greens and chickpeas, served with rice. (7+13+15) Kays — 7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Beef chilli con carne with roasted sweet potato, topped with cheese and spring onion. With tortilla chips, Greek yoghurt, tomatillo salsa, chilli sauce and coriander. The dish is gluten free. (6+15) GREEN DISH: Dish Soy protein chilli sin carne with roasted sweet potato, topped with cheese and spring onion. With tortilla chips, Greek yoghurt, tomatillo salsa, chilli sauce and coriander. Gluten free and also made vegan. (6+7+15) Kays — 7:30 a.m. to 5 p.m.
